Thirty floors up, the stairs are the only way out… and tonight, something big just walked into the building.
Last time, someone knocked on thirty-twelve. Some of you said open it. So you move the dresser and open the door… and his arm is bitten.
Most of you said stay quiet. So you wait… and a note slides under the door. The stairs. It's coming up.
Your phone's at eighteen percent. Airplane mode alone can stretch that by hours.
Then footsteps in the stairwell, heavy and bare. In a stairwell, sound carries up floor after floor.
Through the peephole… the hunter reaches your floor.
Hide in the tub… or climb down to the balcony below? Comment one or two.
